Historical Archive • 2667 CE

Chess 2667: Orbital Citadel

In the year 2667 CE, grandmaster chess is contested aboard levitating Quantum Stepwell Citadels hovering two kilometers above futuristic Bengaluru.

Two orbital divisions vie for supremacy:

  • Solar Gold Division (White): Commanded by Commander Vanguard, fielding sculpted solar-brass alloy pieces with fusion halo cores.
  • Quantum Cyan Division (Black): Guided by the neural super-intelligence Nexus-9 AI Core, fielding obsidian-cyan nanotech pieces.

All standard FIDE chess rules apply—including Castling, En Passant, and 8th-Rank Pawn Promotion.
